plain.zh: 把模型包在中间的那层程序：接需求、发工具、收结果
plain.en: the program wrapped around the model: it takes the request, hands out tools, checks permission, brings back the answer

analogy.zh: 马只出力气；辕、衡、车厢决定它拉什么、走哪条路
analogy.en: the horse only pulls; shafts, yoke and carriage decide what gets hauled and which road it takes

why.zh: 模型光会说话做不了事，注册、校验、把关、纠错这些杂事得有一层统一兜住，随手封装挡不住。
why.en: No one of those problems is hard alone, but a thin wrapper leaves each for the next layer to trip over; the harness takes them all in one place.

plain.zh: 问一次模型、跑一轮工具、再问一次，直到任务做完
plain.en: ask the model, run the tools it asks for, ask again, until the task is finished

analogy.zh: 像心跳：一问一跑是一拍，任务了结才停
analogy.en: a heartbeat: one ask and one act is one beat, and it stops when the work is done

why.zh: 模型一次只走一步，工具跑完的结果得喂回去它才能定下一步，所以只能一轮轮转，直到不再要工具。
why.en: The model moves one step at a time; tool results must go back in before it can pick the next action, so the loop turns until it stops asking for tools.

plain.zh: 边算边一段段往外交结果的函数，取一段停一段
plain.en: a function that hands out results one piece at a time and can pause between pieces

analogy.zh: 像流水线厨师，做好一盘递一盘，不等全桌菜齐
analogy.en: a cook passing dishes out as each is ready, not after the whole meal is done

why.zh: 回复是一段段到的、工具要跑好几分钟，等全算完再交结果，界面就僵在那儿，也来不及喊停。
why.en: Replies trickle in and tools run for minutes, so a function returning only at the end would freeze the screen and leave no chance to stop it in time.

plain.zh: 交出一个结果，然后停在原地等对方来取下一个
plain.en: hand out one value, then sit still until the caller asks for the next

analogy.zh: 出菜口：炒好一盘举起来，服务员取走才炒下一盘
analogy.en: the wok pass: hold up a plate and wait for the runner to take it

why.zh: 每走一步就把当下的动静交出去，外面看着就够，不必另装一套监听或回调去追问进度。
why.en: Each step hands out whatever just happened, so the caller needs no extra event listeners or callbacks to keep track of progress.

plain.zh: 下游处理不过来，就反过来让上游慢一点
plain.en: when the consumer falls behind, it pushes the producer to slow down

analogy.zh: 下水道堵了，得有人去把水龙头拧小
analogy.en: a clogged drain sends someone running to turn the tap down

why.zh: 出得快、看得慢时，取的人不来拿，做的人就先停手；不然一屏屏日志会把内存堆爆。
why.en: Nothing more is produced until the consumer takes the last item; otherwise a flood of tool output piles up in memory and the whole program crashes.

plain.zh: 一边只管做、一边只管用，两边速度不同就得协调
plain.en: one side only makes, the other only takes; their speeds rarely match

analogy.zh: 分拣带跑得比唯一一名装车员快，包裹就堆成山
analogy.en: a parcel belt moving faster than the single worker loading trucks

plain.zh: 两件事同时抢着改同一份数据，结果取决于谁手快
plain.en: two paths touch the same data at once; the outcome depends on timing

analogy.zh: 两个收银员同时从同一格抽屉拿钱找零，账必乱
analogy.en: two cashiers grabbing change from the same drawer at the same second

why.zh: 两块工具抢着改同一份状态，谁读到半截数据全看手快手慢，出了错还几乎复现不出来。
why.en: When tools overwrite shared state, who reads half-written data depends on timing, and the resulting bug is nearly impossible to reproduce.

plain.zh: 同一件事做一次和做五遍，最后结果一模一样
plain.en: doing it once or five times leaves exactly the same result

analogy.zh: 电梯按钮按一次和按十次，都只来一趟
analogy.en: pressing the lift button once or ten times still brings one trip

why.zh: 改文件靠内容对上号，不靠第几行；哪怕别处已被改过，只要那段还在，就不会改到错地方。
why.en: The edit finds its target by content rather than by line number, so even if the file changed elsewhere it still lands right, as long as that text survives.

plain.zh: 把内存里的对象摊平成一段文字，好存好发；反过来叫还原
plain.en: flattening an object into text so it can be stored or sent, and undoing it

analogy.zh: 家具拆平装箱寄走，到货后再按原样拼回去
analogy.en: flat-packing furniture into a box, then rebuilding it at the other end

why.zh: 配置要落盘就得摊成文字，而回调是内存里跑着的代码，摊不平，因此函数钩子写不进配置。
why.en: Saving a config means flattening it into text, but a callback is live code in memory and cannot be flattened, so function hooks cannot be persisted.

plain.zh: 把流程画成几个格子，箭头规定哪格能跳到哪格
plain.en: a flow drawn as boxes, with arrows listing the legal jumps

analogy.zh: 售货机：投币、选货、出货，跳错一步机器不认
analogy.en: a vending machine: coin in, select, dispense, never out of order

why.zh: 话没说完工具就开跑，靠固定的几格把顺序卡住，快是快了，结果也不会摆乱。
why.en: Tools start before the reply finishes, and the fixed stages hold them in line, so the run gains speed without scrambling the results.

plain.zh: 要用的东西不自己造，而是由外面递进来，随时能换
plain.en: you don't build what you need; it's handed in from outside and swappable

analogy.zh: 食材由助手送进来，主厨换成谁，菜谱照用
analogy.en: a prep cook delivers the ingredients, so the chef can be swapped out

plain.zh: 测试时用的假替身，照剧本回应，不去碰真的外部服务
plain.en: a stand-in built for tests that answers from a script instead of the real thing

analogy.zh: 演习时请人扮客户，照台词问答，不是真买家
analogy.en: an actor playing the customer during rehearsal, reading from a script

why.zh: 假件从接口塞进来，不碰真服务；测试不绑模块内部，模块改名或搬家，不会一大片跟着坏。
why.en: Fakes come in through the interface instead of per-module spies: rename or move a module and a pile of tests needn't change, cached state can't leak between them.

plain.zh: 全程只许存在一份的对象，谁来拿都是同一个
plain.en: one shared instance for the whole program; everyone gets the same one

analogy.zh: 办公室只有一台打印机，所有人都排同一条队
analogy.en: the office has one printer and everyone queues at the same machine

why.zh: 文件埋在程序里，用到才落到磁盘；几个调用同时开口也只摊一份，免得两遍写入撞在一起。
why.en: The files ride inside the program and reach disk only on first use; simultaneous calls share one extraction, so nothing gets written twice mid-race.

plain.zh: 谁关心就登记，事一发生挨个通知，发事的不用认识谁
plain.en: anyone interested signs up; when something happens, all get told

analogy.zh: 物业在业主群发一条通知，不必挨家敲门
analogy.en: the property manager posts once in the residents' group chat

why.zh: 发事的用不着认识谁在听：谁想插手谁自己登记，核心循环一行不改就能长出新行为。
why.en: The emitter never learns who listens: whatever wants in signs itself up, so new behaviour attaches without editing a line of the core loop.

plain.zh: 一件事依次经手多人，谁有权限谁拦下，否则往后传
plain.en: a request passes down a line; whoever can handle it stops it there

analogy.zh: 报销单从组长到经理再到财务，一级级往上签
analogy.en: an expense form travels from team lead to manager to finance

why.zh: 同一件事上挂着几条规则，按高低一个个过手，只要有一条喊停就真停，主循环不必把它们全写死。
why.en: Several rules hang on one event and run in rank order; any one of them can veto the call, so the loop needn't hardcode their logic.

plain.zh: 先留个空类型位，用时才填，一份定义套多种数据
plain.en: a type slot left blank until use, so one definition fits many data kinds

analogy.zh: 同一款收纳箱，能装鞋也能装书，看放什么
analogy.en: one storage bin design that holds shoes or books, depending on you

plain.zh: 一个位置只允许列出的几种形状之一，用前得先分辨是哪种
plain.en: one slot holding any of several listed shapes; you must tell which first

analogy.zh: 信封里可能是发票、贺卡或照片，拆开先看是哪样
analogy.en: an envelope with an invoice, card, or photo - open it to see which

plain.zh: 函数带着它出生时的环境一起走，别人够不着那份数据
plain.en: a function that carries its birth environment wherever it goes

analogy.zh: 店员随身带自己那串仓库钥匙，别的柜台借不到
analogy.en: a clerk keeps her own stockroom keys; no other counter can borrow them

why.zh: 每起一场对话就新造一份私有格子，状态全在函数里；换成类，几场同时跑会共踩同一份属性。
why.en: Each conversation builds its own private box of state; done with a class instead, concurrent dialogs would tread on one shared set of properties.

plain.zh: 一张“将来给你结果”的凭条，只兑一次，成或败都算交代
plain.en: a receipt for a value that arrives later; it settles exactly once

analogy.zh: 修表给张取货单，只兑一次：修好了或没修好
analogy.en: a claim check from the watchmaker: you redeem it once, done or not

why.zh: 回复是一个字一个字到的，凭条只兑一次；要一路推事件，就得换个能反复交货的东西。
why.en: Replies trickle in token by token but a receipt redeems only once; carrying a running event stream needs something that hands over goods again and again.

plain.zh: 把接下来要做的事托给对方，他办完再回头喊你
plain.en: you hand over what to do next and get called when it finishes

analogy.zh: 修手机留个号，修好打给你；留十个号就乱成粥
analogy.en: leave your number for repairs; chain ten of them and you lose track

why.zh: 事件种类只会越加越多，每加一种就得再托一个人、多一处收尾，处理逻辑散得没人理得清。
why.en: Event kinds only multiply, and each new one means another helper to register and another loose end, until the handling logic is too scattered to keep up.

plain.zh: 上面一喊停，底下每一层都收到停，各自收尾
plain.en: a stop call at the top reaches every layer below, each wrapping up

analogy.zh: 导演喊卡，摄影、灯光、场务一层层传下去收工
analogy.en: the director calls cut; camera, lights and crew all wrap up

why.zh: 关掉生成器只是不再听，正等回音的请求和子进程照跑；停的信号得一层层递下去各自收尾。
why.en: Closing the loop only stops the reading; pending requests and child processes keep going, so the stop signal must travel down every layer to wrap up.

plain.zh: 一个能随时按下的停止开关，正在干活的得自己去瞅它
plain.en: a stop switch anyone can flip; running work must check it to bail out

analogy.zh: 车间的急停按钮，每台机器动手前都先看一眼
analogy.en: the shop-floor emergency stop that every machine glances at

why.zh: 生成器关不掉正在等的请求和外部读写，得让工具、接口和子进程自己去查一个信号，取消才算真停了。
why.en: A generator cannot interrupt a pending wait or cancel outside I/O; tools, APIs and subprocesses must check a signal themselves for a stop to stick.

plain.zh: 数据不涂改，要改就整份抄新的再改，旧的照原样留着
plain.en: never overwrite data; copy it, change the copy, keep the original

analogy.zh: 病历不改原页，每次另开一张，原单留档可查
analogy.en: a chart is never erased; each change goes on a fresh page

why.zh: 状态从不原地涂改，变化就可预测、可追溯、可调试；父级敢把快照交给子智能体，回滚也简单安全。
why.en: Because state is never edited in place, changes stay predictable, traceable and debuggable, and a parent can hand a snapshot to a child agent safely.

plain.zh: 算数的同时还改了外面：写文件、发消息、动全局状态
plain.en: besides computing, it also changes things outside itself: files, messages, state

analogy.zh: 只是去问个路，顺手把人家的花盆碰倒了
analogy.en: you only asked for directions, then knocked over their flowerpot

plain.zh: 卡在原地干等，等的时候什么都干不了
plain.en: stuck waiting in place, unable to do anything else meanwhile

analogy.zh: 银行只开一个窗口，前面慢，整队人干站着
analogy.en: one teller window, and the whole line stands still behind a slow customer

why.zh: 模型的话是一段段到的，界面得边到边画；主线程一停下来死等，实时感当场就没了。
why.en: Responses arrive in pieces and the UI must draw them as they land, so nothing may sit and wait on the main thread.

plain.zh: 几件事同时在推进，抢同一份资源就得安排先后
plain.en: several tasks in flight at once, competing for shared things

analogy.zh: 四个厨师一口锅，同时开火就排班定谁先用
analogy.en: four cooks on one stove: someone has to set the order

why.zh: 只读的搜索和读取并到一轮里跑能省一大截等待，把有副作用的也放进来就会互相踩出查不出的怪结果。
why.en: Bunching reads and searches into one turn saves real waiting; let a side-effecting tool join the batch and they race, producing behavior nobody can predict.

plain.zh: 连着失败够多次就先跳过这步，别硬试拖累全局
plain.en: after enough failures in a row it skips the call instead of dragging everything

analogy.zh: 家里电闸跳了，先断一路，别让整栋楼烧起来
analogy.en: the fuse blows and cuts one line before the whole house burns

why.zh: 压缩失败后会一轮轮接着重试，有会话连着撞了三千多次，一天白烧二十五万次调用，够多次就该断掉。
why.en: Failed compactions were retried round after round: some sessions stacked over fifty in a row, up to 3,272, wasting roughly 250K API calls a day.

plain.zh: 出问题时不整个瘫掉，砍掉非必要部分，保住还能用的
plain.en: on failure, drop the nice-to-haves and keep the core running

analogy.zh: 航班超售，先减免费餐食，飞机照飞
analogy.en: the flight is oversold: cut the free meals but still take off

why.zh: 启动是必经的初始化，钩子写错也不该拖得整个系统起不来；核心功能不能被扩展点劫持。
why.en: Session start is plain initialization: if a hook could block it, one bad config would keep the whole system from starting; extensions must not hijack core function.

plain.zh: 每次重试之间等得越来越久，别追着人家猛敲门
plain.en: wait longer between each retry instead of hammering a struggling service

analogy.zh: 店没开门，隔一分、两分、四分再去问一次
analogy.en: if the shop isn't open, ask again after one, two, then four minutes

why.zh: 服务器只是暂时不通，追着连只会给它压上加压；间隔翻倍能喘口气，又不至于错过它刚缓过来。
why.en: While a server is briefly unreachable, fast retries only pile on its load; doubling the gap gives it room without sleeping past its recovery.

plain.zh: 要用的东西已在手边备好的比例，低了就得现跑现取
plain.en: how often the thing you want is already kept nearby, ready to grab

analogy.zh: 常用工具挂墙上，伸手就有和得跑仓库的比例
analogy.en: the share of jobs where the tool is on the wall, not in the warehouse

plain.zh: 出厂前把永远跑不到的代码整块扔掉，成品更小也不透密
plain.en: the build strips code that can never run, shrinking the artifact

analogy.zh: 搬家时从没穿过的衣服不进箱，箱子小一半
analogy.en: clothes you never wear never make it into the moving box

plain.zh: 打包时抖落用不上的分支代码，只留真被摇到的那几根
plain.en: shaking unused branches off the bundle so only reachable code ships

analogy.zh: 装箱前把没贴标签的配件全抖回货架，箱里只剩要用的
analogy.en: before packing, shake off every unlabelled part back onto the shelf

plain.zh: 用到的那一刻才去取，没用到就一直不搬进来
plain.en: fetch a thing only when it's first needed, not all at the start

analogy.zh: 餐馆不预先摆满桌，来一桌客人摆一桌
analogy.en: the cafe sets out tables only as guests arrive

plain.zh: A 要等 B 先就绪，B 又回头等 A，谁都起不了步
plain.en: A waits for B ready and B waits for A ready, so neither can start

analogy.zh: 开箱要钥匙，钥匙又锁在箱子里
analogy.en: the key to the box is locked inside the box

plain.zh: 攒着不放的东西太多，撑爆存放处，程序当场倒下
plain.en: too much kept at once runs out of room and the process dies

analogy.zh: 购物车越堆越高，最后顶穿了仓库屋顶
analogy.en: piles keep growing until they punch through the storeroom roof

plain.zh: 写一串模式符号，让机器照它在文本里筛出匹配的内容
plain.en: a pattern string the machine uses to pick out matching text

analogy.zh: 门卫只认“两位字母加四位数字”，照格式放车
analogy.en: the gatekeeper accepts only two letters plus four digits

plain.zh: 圈一块受限的地方让代码玩，出事也溅不到外面
plain.en: an enclosed area where code plays without touching anything outside

analogy.zh: 小区里的儿童沙坑，玩脏了也不糟蹋别家花园
analogy.en: a kids' sandpit inside the compound; the mess stays in it

why.zh: 沙箱里的命令够不着外面的系统，风险已经压低了，就不必每条都弹窗问一遍用户。
why.en: Commands in the sandbox cannot reach the system outside it, so their risk is already cut low enough to skip asking the user before each one.

plain.zh: 只发刚好够干这活的权限，多一分都不给
plain.en: grant only what this task needs and nothing more

analogy.zh: 保洁的工牌只开储物间，开不了金库
analogy.en: the cleaner's badge opens the supply room, never the vault

why.zh: 只给刚好够用的本事，改一行比重写整份文件更快也更不容易失手，权限收窄顺带把出错一起省掉。
why.en: Grant only the ability a step needs: editing one line is faster and less error-prone than rewriting the whole file, so tightening rights also trims mistakes.

plain.zh: 每块代码只管自己那件事，别把判断和跑腿搅一起
plain.en: each piece of code handles one job and doesn't mix in another's

analogy.zh: 后厨切配的管切配、掌勺的管掌勺，不互相插手
analogy.en: the prep cook preps, the wok cook cooks; they don't cross lines

plain.zh: 发生的事一条条排队送出来，边到边处理，不等攒齐
plain.en: happenings come out one by one and are handled as they arrive

analogy.zh: 传送带一件件出包裹，扫一件贴一件
analogy.en: parcels come down the belt one at a time, scanned as they land

why.zh: 一次请求里动静会连着冒个没完，只回一次的应答装不下，只好一条条排队送出去。
why.en: Events keep surfacing through one request, and a reply that sounds once cannot carry them, so they queue up and leave one by one.

plain.zh: 结果一点点到就一点点用；书里指模型回复逐字涌出
plain.en: handle bits as they land; here, the model's reply arrives word by word

analogy.zh: 接自来水不必等水缸装满，开着龙头就能洗
analogy.en: wash under the running tap instead of waiting for the tub to fill

why.zh: 回复本就是一段段到的，非要等齐了才显示，人就只能对着一片空白干等。
why.en: The reply already arrives in pieces; holding it until it is whole leaves the reader staring at a blank screen.

plain.zh: 会广播动静的物件，谁想听谁自己来挂上监听
plain.en: an object that broadcasts happenings to whoever subscribed

analogy.zh: 门口那台大喇叭，要听的人自己搬椅子来坐
analogy.en: a loudspeaker by the door; listeners bring their own chairs

why.zh: 监听器挂上忘了摘，内存悄悄漏光；事件名是随手写的字，打错了也没人拦。
why.en: Listeners never removed slowly leak memory, and an event name is just a hand-typed string, so a typo slips through.

plain.zh: 跑起来那一刻才查数据合不合规格，当场挡住脏输入
plain.en: checking the data while the program runs, so bad input stops right there

analogy.zh: 快递进站还得过一台称重和查违禁品的机器
analogy.en: packages are still weighed and screened as they enter the depot

why.zh: 模型的输出没法保证守规矩，参数动手前得当场过一遍筛，脏的立刻挡在门外。
why.en: Model output can't be trusted to be well-formed, so arguments are screened right before the tool runs and bad ones stop at the gate.

plain.zh: 把某一瞬间的全部原样抄一份留着，之后怎么变都不影响它
plain.en: a copy of everything at one instant, untouched by later changes

analogy.zh: 出门前拍张桌面照，回来再乱也有底可查
analogy.en: photograph the desk before leaving; later mess can't change the photo

plain.zh: 一件彻底办完才轮到下一件，中间绝不重叠
plain.en: one job finishes completely before the next one starts

analogy.zh: 独木桥一次只过一辆车，后头的排队等
analogy.en: a single-plank bridge: one vehicle at a time, the rest queue

plain.zh: 把往外逐个交活这整件事，转包给另一段同样的代码
plain.en: delegate the whole hand-out job to another generator and pass its output along

analogy.zh: 组长说“这段小刘全程负责，你们直接找他”
analogy.en: the shift lead says: Liu owns this section end to end, go to him

plain.zh: 能主动让位、之后从让处接着跑的一段流程
plain.en: a routine that gives up the floor and resumes exactly where it stopped

analogy.zh: 织毛衣打个结放下，明天从那一针接着织
analogy.en: tie the yarn and set knitting down; tomorrow you resume that stitch

plain.zh: 同一件事备几套做法，按情况挑一套，主干不动
plain.en: several interchangeable ways for one job; pick one, core code unchanged

analogy.zh: 外卖平台可切“最快”或“最省”路线，骑手照单跑
analogy.en: the app swaps fastest or cheapest routing; riders just follow

plain.zh: 中间垫一层做转换，两边各说各话也能接上
plain.en: a middle layer translates so two mismatched sides connect

analogy.zh: 旅行转换插头，圆脚插进扁孔，电器不用改
analogy.en: a travel plug adapter: round pins into flat holes, no rewiring

plain.zh: 专门造东西的一道工序，规格统一，要几个现造几个
plain.en: a routine whose only job is building objects to one spec, on demand

analogy.zh: 酱料台每份照同一配方现调，不提前大批做
analogy.en: the sauce station builds each portion to the same recipe, to order

plain.zh: 一份书面格式说明：这段数据该有哪些字段、各是什么类型
plain.en: a written spec of which fields a payload must carry and their types

analogy.zh: 报名表印好必填栏目，填错的当场退回
analogy.en: the form prints required boxes; a wrongly filled one bounces back

plain.zh: 一次把整包数据里的各部件分名别类取出，省得逐个翻
plain.en: pull many named parts out of one bundle in a single move

analogy.zh: 快递一到就分拣：笔放桌上、衣服进衣柜
analogy.en: the parcel lands: pen to the desk, clothes to the closet, at once

plain.zh: 一组改动要么全生效要么全不生效，不会改到一半
plain.en: a batch of changes either all land or none does, never halfway

analogy.zh: 点菜要么整单进厨房，不会上两道下两道
analogy.en: the order goes to the kitchen whole or not at all

plain.zh: 立个牌子写明“这条已作废”，而不是悄悄抹掉
plain.en: a marker saying this entry is dead, instead of silently removing it

analogy.zh: 档案柜留一张“此件已撤销”的空夹，免得有人再找
analogy.en: a folder marked withdrawn stays so nobody hunts for the original

plain.zh: 两边各握着对方要的东西都不撒手，一起僵住不动
plain.en: each side holds what the other needs and neither lets go

analogy.zh: 两辆车在独木桥两头互不相让，谁都动不了
analogy.en: two cars meet on a narrow bridge and neither reverses

plain.zh: 一看出事立刻停手报错，不硬撑到后面代价更大
plain.en: stop at the first sign of trouble instead of pushing on at higher cost

analogy.zh: 发现鸡蛋坏了就停手，别把整锅料都倒下去
analogy.en: if the egg is bad, stop; don't pour the whole batter in

plain.zh: 一处出问题把压力传给邻居，一路跟着倒，越滚越大
plain.en: one failure loads its neighbours, which fail too, compounding outward

analogy.zh: 一台收银机死机，旁边几条队全堵住了
analogy.en: one checkout lane dies and the lines beside it pile up

plain.zh: 程序约定好的三个口：喂进去的话、打印的话、抱怨的话
plain.en: three agreed channels: what you feed in, what it prints, what it complains

analogy.zh: 服务窗口分三栏：收件、出件、投诉，各走各的
analogy.en: the counter has three slots: intake, output, complaints

plain.zh: 一条一直留着的双向通道，两头随时都能主动开口
plain.en: a connection kept open so either side can speak up any time

analogy.zh: 不是写信等回信，而是电话不挂，随时能插话
analogy.en: not letters back and forth but a phone line left open

plain.zh: 给第三方一张限额授权的通行条，不必交出主密码
plain.en: hands a third party a limited pass instead of your main password

analogy.zh: 酒店房卡只开你那间，开不了保险柜和别家门
analogy.en: the hotel key opens your room only, not the safe or other doors

plain.zh: 跑这类程序的一套引擎，兼管出厂打包，书里图它起得快
plain.en: the engine that runs and builds the program; chosen here for speed

analogy.zh: 小作坊一台多功能机床，顶过去两台老机器
analogy.en: one multi-tool machine in the shop replaces two older ones

plain.zh: 把散在各处的零件压成一份成品，好分发、好起跑
plain.en: squash many source files into one distributable artifact

analogy.zh: 寄件前把零散东西装进同一个箱、贴同一张单
analogy.en: loose parts go into one carton with one label before shipping

plain.zh: 出厂定稿的那一刻，跟跑起来才现场决定相对
plain.en: the moment the program is built, as opposed to while it runs

analogy.zh: 书在印刷厂定稿，便签是读者拿到后自己贴
analogy.en: the book is fixed at the printer; sticky notes come later, by readers

plain.zh: 啥都没预热，从零把程序拉起来花的那段时间
plain.en: bringing the program up from nothing, with nothing warmed beforehand

analogy.zh: 冬天早上第一次发动车，得热一会儿才肯走
analogy.en: a winter morning: the engine idles a while before it will move

plain.zh: 还没用上就先把要的东西搬到手边，用时不必现等
plain.en: fetch what you'll need before you need it, so nothing waits later

analogy.zh: 高峰前先把米泡上、料切好，客人一到就开炒
analogy.en: soak the rice and chop the veg before the rush, not during it

plain.zh: 没人再引用的内存由系统定时清走，别的资源仍要自己收尾
plain.en: the runtime reclaims memory nothing references; other resources don't

analogy.zh: 物业收走没人认领的杂物，你自己的水桶得自己倒
analogy.en: the building hauls away abandoned stuff; you still empty your own bin

plain.zh: 给天下文字统一编号的一张表，各系统认字不打架
plain.en: one shared numbering table so every system reads the same characters

analogy.zh: 各国商品统一条码，扫码机不管货是哪国产的
analogy.en: one barcode system so the scanner works regardless of country

plain.zh: 备好的那份不再算数，得扔掉重做，白白慢一次
plain.en: the kept copy no longer counts, so it's thrown out and rebuilt

analogy.zh: 菜单改了价，印好的传单全作废，只能重印
analogy.en: prices changed, so the flyers are scrap and need reprinting

plain.zh: 从最开头一路走到最结尾，中间每一环都真连上
plain.en: all the way from the first step to the last, every link real

analogy.zh: 从下单到签收走一遍，不是只在仓库里试打包
analogy.en: order it and receive it, not just rehearse packing in the warehouse

plain.zh: 新旧两版同时上线，各给一部分人用，比谁效果好
plain.en: run two versions for different slices of users at once and compare

analogy.zh: 收银台左边试新流程、右边留老流程，一周看哪边快
analogy.en: one lane tries the new flow, the other keeps the old, then compare

plain.zh: 事先列好许可名册，名册外一律挡在门外
plain.en: a prepared list of the permitted; everything else is denied

analogy.zh: 小区门禁认名册，不在册的刷不开
analogy.en: the gate opens only for names on the resident list

plain.zh: 一个指路牌式的假条目，打开它其实走到别处的真文件
plain.en: a shortcut entry that quietly sends you to a file somewhere else

analogy.zh: 柜上贴条“东西在储藏室”，你照条去拿，柜里是空的
analogy.en: a note says the box is in the storage room, so you go there

plain.zh: 层层关卡各管一段，漏了一层还有下一层兜着
plain.en: several independent checks in a row; if one leaks, the next catches

analogy.zh: 机场先值机、再过安检、登机口还查一次证件
analogy.en: check-in, then security, then another ID check at the gate

plain.zh: 为赶工欠下的马虎账，日后要连本带利花时间还
plain.en: the shortcut you take today, paid back with interest later

analogy.zh: 偷懒不洗油烟机，三个月后炒什么都带糊味
analogy.en: skip cleaning the hood tonight; in three months every dish tastes burnt

plain.zh: 代码里留的一道闸，不重装机就能让某功能开或关
plain.en: a built-in switch that turns a capability on or off without rebuilding

analogy.zh: 店里总电闸旁边的分闸，想关凉菜间就扳下那一路
analogy.en: a sub-breaker beside the main one: cut the salad station only

plain.zh: 一轮允许花掉的篇幅上限，快到线就提醒或收尾
plain.en: the cap on how much text a round may spend before it wraps up

analogy.zh: 逛市场给了固定现钱，快到数就先停手别加菜
analogy.en: you set a cash cap at the market and stop before it's gone

plain.zh: Agent 动手前该找谁批准、多久问一次的规矩
plain.en: the rule for who approves each action, and how often the agent has to stop and ask

analogy.zh: 小区门禁：业主登记过就随便进，访客每次都得刷卡
analogy.en: a gated community: residents wave through, every visitor is stopped and logged at the gate

why.zh: 一档开关不够用，问太勤烦人，全放开又危险，于是把松紧排成好几个档位。
why.en: One setting fits nobody: asking every time wears you down, never asking is too risky, so strictness comes graded across several modes.

plain.zh: 每次调用工具都要连闯的几道关卡，任一道说停就停
plain.en: several gates every tool call must pass in order; if any gate says stop, it stops right there

analogy.zh: 机场安检：证件、X 光、人身检查，一层不过就登不上机
analogy.en: airport security: ID check, X-ray, body scan -- fail one station and you never reach the plane

why.zh: 只守一道门，绕过就全完了；关卡一层压一层，前一层失手，后一层还能拦下。
why.en: Guard one door and slipping it lets everything through; stacked stages mean a later one still stops what an earlier one missed.

plain.zh: 在关键节点外挂一段你自己的脚本，时刻一到就自动跑
plain.en: your own script hung on a lifecycle moment so it runs by itself when that moment arrives

analogy.zh: 门框上的门铃磁铁：门一开就响，不用重新布线
analogy.en: a doorbell magnet on the frame: the door opens, it rings, and the house wiring stays untouched

why.zh: 关键节点上留个插座，外面接话不必改内核，内核也不必知道有谁接了。
why.en: Key nodes leave a socket open, so outside code can join without editing the core, and the core never learns anyone joined.

plain.zh: 每轮对话都置顶的岗位说明书：它是谁、能做什么、听谁的
plain.en: the standing instruction sent on top of every request: who it is, what it may do, what it must obey

analogy.zh: 新员工入职手册，每天开工前都要重念一遍
analogy.en: the onboarding handbook a new hire rereads before every single shift

why.zh: 它是每轮都要重发的开头，拼法一抖、字节一变，先前攒的缓存整段作废。
why.en: It heads every request and is resent each turn, so one wobble in assembly changes the bytes and voids the whole cache.

plain.zh: 模型一轮能装下的内容总量上限，装满了就得把旧的挤出去
plain.en: how much text the model can hold in mind at once; new material pushes the oldest material off the edge

analogy.zh: 一块固定大小的白板，要写新东西必须先擦掉最早几行
analogy.en: a whiteboard of fixed size: to write anything new you first erase the oldest lines

why.zh: 模型能看见的只有窗口里那些，话越攒越长，迟早顶到边，得决定先挤掉谁。
why.en: The model sees only what fits in the window; history keeps piling up until it hits the ceiling, so something must be squeezed out.

plain.zh: 聊天快装满时，把前面的内容自动折成一份摘要
plain.en: when the chat nears full, the harness summarizes the earlier part so the conversation can keep going

analogy.zh: 连续剧太长了，先播两分钟前情提要再继续拍
analogy.en: a long serialized drama: play two minutes of recap before shooting the next episode

why.zh: 窗口有上限，历史只增不减；前面三步都腾不出空间、用量越过阈值，才把整段对话折成一份摘要。
why.en: The window is capped while history only grows; when the three lighter passes fail to free space and usage crosses the threshold, everything gets folded into one summary.

plain.zh: 一次动作的返回内容：文件正文、命令输出或报错，被塞回对话
plain.en: what an action hands back -- file text, command output or an error -- fed into the chat as a new message

analogy.zh: 跑腿买回来的菜和小票，得摆在桌上让人看得见
analogy.en: the groceries and the receipt the runner brings back, both laid on the table where you can see them

why.zh: 模型只读得到消息，看不见机器里的现场，所以结果要当成新的用户消息发回去，它才知道这步成没成。
why.en: The model reads only messages and cannot see the machine, so output comes back as a new user-role message; otherwise it never learns whether the step worked.

plain.zh: 被派出去办一件小事的另一条对话线，办完只带回结论
plain.en: a second agent spawned for one small task with its own message history, reporting back only the answer

analogy.zh: 老板派实习生查资料，实习生只把结论带回会议室
analogy.en: the boss sends an intern to dig up data; the intern returns with the conclusion, not the whole archive

why.zh: 派出去的活另开一条对话线，消息列表不与父方共用，里头怎么试都改不到父智能体的状态。
why.en: Each dispatched task runs on its own message list, not a shared one, so whatever it tries in there cannot modify the parent agent's state.

plain.zh: 只派活、收结论，自己从不动手写代码的那个角色
plain.en: the one agent that splits the work among workers and merges their answers without touching tools itself

analogy.zh: 工地上的包工头：分派任务、验收成果，不亲自砌砖
analogy.en: a site foreman: assigns tasks and inspects results, but never lays a brick himself

why.zh: 它只派活和收结论，代码一行不写；模块瘦到三百来行，就不至于变成整台机器的堵点和故障源。
why.en: It assigns work and collects results, writing no code; keeping the module to roughly three hundred lines stops it becoming a bottleneck or a failure point.

plain.zh: 一份事先写好的操作说明书，被点到时交给模型照着做
plain.en: a written-down procedure the model can be handed and follow, instead of being re-taught every time

analogy.zh: 厨房墙上的菜谱，客人点这道菜才取下照着做
analogy.en: a recipe card on the kitchen wall: pulled down only when that dish is ordered

why.zh: 说明书不提前全摊在桌上，用到哪张才取哪张，省得白白吃下启动时间和内存。
why.en: Skill manuals are not all spread out in advance; one is pulled only when used, saving the startup time and memory they would waste sitting idle.

plain.zh: 按统一协议接在外面的服务，给 Agent 补上额外的工具和资料
plain.en: an outside program that speaks one shared protocol, handing the agent extra tools and data

analogy.zh: 家电都插同一种插座，不必为每个牌子配转换头
analogy.en: appliances all plugging into the same socket, so no brand needs its own adapter

why.zh: 没有统一标准时，一个工具要给每个平台各写一遍适配；照协议做成服务器，写一次就能被各家接上。
why.en: Without one standard a tool must ship a separate adapter per platform; built as a server to the protocol, it is written once and any client can use it.

plain.zh: 项目里那份说明文件，每次开工都被自动塞进背景里
plain.en: the project's note file, dropped into the background on every start so its rules survive a reset

analogy.zh: 贴在操作台上的店规，每个班次开工先念一遍
analogy.en: the house rules taped to the counter, read out at the start of every shift

why.zh: 店规每轮都要重念一遍，中途被人改过却不重新塞进去，模型就照着过期版本做决定。
why.en: The house rules get re-read every turn; if a mid-session edit is not re-injected, the model keeps deciding from a stale copy of them.

plain.zh: 先只看不改，把方案写清楚给人过目，点头之后才动手
plain.en: a look-but-do-not-touch phase: the agent drafts a proposal first and only edits after you approve it

analogy.zh: 装修先出图纸，签字确认后才允许砸墙
analogy.en: an architect draws the blueprint and gets it signed before a single wall is knocked down

why.zh: 先只读后动手，改主意在画图阶段几乎不花钱，等墙砌错了再返工，代价要大得多。
why.en: Explore read-only first, because changing your mind while planning costs almost nothing and re-doing a wall already built costs far more.

plain.zh: 把此刻的对话原样复制成几份，让几路任务同时开工
plain.en: copying the conversation as it stands into several branches so parallel jobs share one starting point

analogy.zh: 同一张底片洗出好几张照片，再各自上色
analogy.en: printing several photos from one negative, then retouching each print separately

why.zh: 几路并行若各建一份请求，同一段前缀要重复传好几遍；同一时刻分叉出去，前缀一字不差，缓存才认。
why.en: If every parallel branch rebuilt its request, the same long prefix would be re-sent again and again; forking one moment keeps prefixes byte-identical so the cache hits.

plain.zh: 跨对话留在硬盘上的小纸条，下次开机还会被读进来
plain.en: notes kept on disk between conversations and re-read next time, so the agent does not start from zero

analogy.zh: 抽屉里的老客户档案，换人接待也不会重新自我介绍
analogy.en: a drawer of regular-client files: each new clerk opens it instead meeting an old friend as a stranger

plain.zh: 别人打包好的一包能力，装上就多一批工具和命令
plain.en: someone else's bundled package of tools, commands and settings that you install in one go

analogy.zh: 给相机换个镜头，机身不必重造
analogy.en: swapping a lens on the camera rather than rebuilding the body

plain.zh: 从打开到退出的一段连续对话，中途记录会被存下来
plain.en: one continuous run of conversation whose history can be saved and picked up again later

analogy.zh: 一通电话：挂了可以重拨，之前说过的还在录音里
analogy.en: a phone call: hang up and redial, and the earlier words are still on the recording

plain.zh: 一整段对话被逐条写成的流水账，恢复和审计都靠它
plain.en: the message-by-message log of a conversation, used to resume it later or to audit what actually happened

analogy.zh: 法庭速记稿：散庭后照着它复原当天每句话
analogy.en: the court stenographer's pages: after the session ends, they are what the day is rebuilt from

plain.zh: 前面那段没变的话服务端已经记着，不必重新算钱重新算时间
plain.en: the service remembers the unchanged front part of your request, so it is neither re-processed nor re-charged

analogy.zh: 演员已背熟的台词不必再排，只排新加的那几句
analogy.en: lines the cast already knows need no rehearsal; only the new ones take stage time

plain.zh: 另一个模型替你估计这次操作危不危险，决定放行还是来问你
plain.en: a second model that judges how risky an action looks, so it can approve or escalate without waiting for you

analogy.zh: 地铁口的预检员：看一眼就放行，可疑的才送去人工开包
analogy.en: the clerk at the station entrance: waves most people through and sends only the odd bag to a hand check

plain.zh: 开场先只报工具名字，真要用了才把完整说明书取来
plain.en: the model first sees only a list of tool names; the full manual is fetched only once it actually needs one

analogy.zh: 餐厅先递目录页，点了菜厨房才拿出详细菜谱
analogy.en: the waiter hands you the list of dish names first; the full recipe sheet comes out only after you order

plain.zh: 外部服务摆出来给 Agent 翻阅的现成资料，只能读不能执行
plain.en: readable data an outside service exposes -- files, records, docs -- as opposed to actions it can run

analogy.zh: 冰箱里的食材：可以拿出来看，不能指望它自己变熟
analogy.en: the pantry: you may take things out and look at them, but nothing in there cooks itself

plain.zh: 你按停那一刻：正在跑的活要不要立刻收手、留下什么
plain.en: what happens the instant you hit stop: whether the running action is killed and what it leaves behind

analogy.zh: 你喊停的那一秒，厨师关火，锅里半成品怎么处理得先说清
analogy.en: the second you shout stop: the burner goes off, and someone must say what becomes of the half-cooked dish

plain.zh: 这一步做完就退不回去，比如删文件、覆盖数据
plain.en: a flag meaning the action cannot be undone afterwards, so it deserves a stricter warning

analogy.zh: 碎纸机不是文件柜：纸进去就出不来
analogy.en: a shredder, not a filing cabinet: paper that goes in does not come out

plain.zh: 程序运行途中悄悄记下发生了什么，事后传回来供分析
plain.en: the program writes down what happened while running and ships the numbers back for later analysis

analogy.zh: 航班黑匣子：平日没人看，出事时第一个被打开
analogy.en: a flight recorder: nobody reads it day to day, but it is the first thing opened after an incident

plain.zh: 存放选项的纯文本文件，改里面的字段就等于改 Agent 的行为
plain.en: the plain text file where options live: edit a field there and the agent behaves differently next run

analogy.zh: 门口的总开关面板，拨哪个开关，哪个房间就变
analogy.en: the switch panel by the door: flip one breaker and that room changes, no rewiring needed
